race.comment: BEAST FIGHTER (1) has battled home in all 3 starts this season, and maybe having the blinkers on for the first time here can sharpen him up over those final stages. Stick with him on top in this. PLATINUM RUSH (8) has been holding her form all season, and battled away well enough when finishing a well-beaten third here last time out. She has a good gate, and if she can settle a touch better in the running, then she should go close to winning this. ROYAL BUSINESS (12) fought on gamely for fifth fresh up at Cranbourne 11 days ago, and maps to receive the run of the race from a good draw. He strips fitter, and has each-way claims this time. EDGE OF WONDER (3) makes his debut off the back of 3 quiet trials, and the market will be out best guide. CRUSH PUPPY (7) resumes from a spell that would have done her the world of good, and both of her tune-up jump-outs have been good. Include in all combos.
